source.text:
resources:
- name: branches
  type: git
  check_every: 30m
  source:
    version_type: branches
    uri: https://github.com/concourse/examples
    # Could use branch_regex instead if you want
    branch_filters:
      - feat/*
      - feature/*

- name: golang
  type: registry-image
  source:
    repository: golang
    tag: latest

- name: repo
  type: git
  check_every: 30m
  source:
    uri: https://github.com/concourse/examples

jobs:
- name: set-feature-pipelines
  public: true
  plan:
  - in_parallel:
    - get: branches
      trigger: true
    - get: repo

  # creates the ((.:branches)) var
  - load_var: branches
    file: branches/branches.json

  - across:
    # creates the ((.:branch)) var, set to the value of one branch
    - var: branch
      values: ((.:branches))
    do:
      - set_pipeline: ((instance_pipeline_name))
        file: repo/pipelines/multi-branch/template.yml
        instance_vars:
          branch: ((.:branch))

- name: test
  public: true
  plan:
  - in_parallel:
    - get: repo
      trigger: true
    - get: golang
  - task: tests
    image: golang
    file: repo/tasks/go-test.yml
    params: {MODULE: apps/golang}

- name: build
  public: true
  plan:
  - in_parallel:
    - get: repo
      passed: [test]
      trigger: true
    - get: golang
  - task: build
    image: golang
    file: repo/tasks/go-build.yml
    params:
      MODULE: apps/golang
      BINARY_NAME: ascii-banner
  - task: run-binary
    image: golang
    file: repo/apps/golang/binary-test.yml
  # Could then upload the tgz file somewhere like S3

      - id: tests

          MODULE: apps/golang

metadata:
  name: parent

  entrypoint: main
  templates:
    - name: main
      dag:
        tasks:
          - name: build
            template: build
            dependencies:
              - test
          - name: set-feature-pipelines-gate
            template: set-feature-pipelines-gate
          - name: set-feature-pipelines
            template: set-feature-pipelines
            dependencies:
              - set-feature-pipelines-gate
          - name: test-gate
            template: test-gate
          - name: test
            template: test
            dependencies:
              - test-gate
    - name: build
      containerSet:
        containers:
          - name: in-parallel
            image: alpine:3.22
            command:
              - sh
              - -ec
            args:
              - "true"
            workingDir: /workspace
          - name: build
            image: alpine:3.22
            command:
              - sh
              - -ec
            args:
              - "true"
            workingDir: /workspace
            dependencies:
              - in-parallel
          - name: run-binary
            image: alpine:3.22
            command:
              - sh
              - -ec
            args:
              - "true"
            workingDir: /workspace
            dependencies:
              - build
        volumeMounts:
          - name: workspace
            mountPath: /workspace
      volumes:
        - emptyDir: {}
          name: workspace
    - name: set-feature-pipelines-gate
      suspend: {}
    - name: set-feature-pipelines
      containerSet:
        containers:
          - name: branches
            image: alpine:3.22
            command:
              - sh
              - -ec
            args:
              - "true"
            workingDir: /workspace
          - name: across
            image: alpine:3.22
            command:
              - sh
              - -ec
            args:
              - "true"
            workingDir: /workspace
            dependencies:
              - branches
        volumeMounts:
          - name: workspace
            mountPath: /workspace
      volumes:
        - emptyDir: {}
          name: workspace
    - name: test-gate
      suspend: {}
    - name: test
      containerSet:
        containers:
          - name: in-parallel
            image: alpine:3.22
            command:
              - sh
              - -ec
            args:
              - "true"
            workingDir: /workspace
          - name: tests
            image: alpine:3.22
            command:
              - sh
              - -ec
            args:
              - "true"
            workingDir: /workspace
            dependencies:
              - in-parallel
        volumeMounts:
          - name: workspace
            mountPath: /workspace
      volumes:
        - emptyDir: {}
